reproduction.clean_clone_recipe: 本机ignored脚本不随Git克隆；从下列固定Git树URL取得完整路径/size/git-blob-sha1，按记录的selection过滤，从固定raw URL模板取每个常规源文件，校验SHA1('blob '+size+'\0'+bytes)和SHA256，按路径排序写入ZIP_STORED，entry时间1980-01-01T00:00:00、Unix0644。LICENSE/NOTICE保留。

limitations: 源码和license核对、Git blob校验和ZIP CRC不等于源码已构建、模型已运行或策略提升。
独立源码快照与详细文件清单位于被Git忽略的outputs内；本审计进入Git不会上传源码、模型、游戏资产或环境。
其他通用研究参考仓库只盘点本地manifest，未逐一联网升级；本轮重点为四套主要相关代码及实际原生来源Jason。

verification.snapshot_method: Every selected raw blob was verified against its upstream Git blob SHA1 and size, hashed with SHA256, packed in a deterministic stored ZIP, then all entries CRC-checked; a second local pass reverified all blobs without upstream code execution.
verification.reason: Only independent ignored research snapshots and this JSON audit were added; no runtime or training implementation changed.
